limitations: No site measurement, scan registration or as-built survey was supplied.
All numeric plan coordinates are plan-derived; current visual evidence is not used as perspective scale.
Lounge height 3.7 m is an existing visual-model inference, not a clearance measurement.
The current curtain opening, western wall stop, stair curve and wall thickness are not measured.
Kitchen east-west limits retain the qualified 2024 planning extents because no stronger current width source is available.

Magicplan reports two upstairs areas; only the 572.84 sq ft main Mezzanine has an identified footprint. The remaining 124.51 sq ft has no identified shape, room use or photo coverage. It is not the small southwest projection.
No continuous ground-floor stair ascent or measured upper-floor elevation is established by the retained photos and videos.
Office/Machine Room and two legacy iso-room interiors lack confirmed current photo coverage; their furnishings must not be treated as a current inventory.

The Rehearsal southwest door width and position are graphically traced from drawing vectors; no printed width or opening height was found. Its 2.13 m visualization height is inherited from the baseline door convention, not measured.

The Rehearsal iso-booth footprint, horizontal north wall and rough opening are graphically traced from the labeled-2024 inner-face vectors. The source shows paired sliding leaves, but does not establish their current position; the walkthrough visualizes the passage open.

The Recording ISO west doorway and room envelope are graphically traced from labeled-2024 vectors. The former diagonal wall was the source drawing's open door leaf; current room use and door state remain unverified.
